subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in `memory_search` when the existing visibility guard permits them, while keeping broader private cross-conversation recall behind the separate default-off product direction?
rationale: The remaining bug sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and there are two active paths: a narrow live-orphan repair and a broader maintainer-authored private recall feature with compatibility and security-boundary risk.

options.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
options.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep cross-agent and sandbox fail-closed behavior, and continue broader automatic private recall separately.

options.title: Fold into broader recall feature
options.body: Pause the narrow fix and resolve this only through the broader remember-across-conversations product surface once that branch is clean.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Require a combined-store session entry for live transcript hits and treat the remaining recall gap as an intentional privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep cross-agent and sandbox fail-closed behavior, and continue broader automatic private recall separately.

likelyOwner.reason: davemorin owns the overlapping maintainer feature direction for private cross-conversation recall and can decide how the narrow bug fix should coexist with it.
